Address corroborated by LBB ('Durga Chambers, opposite AK Motiwala Jewellers'), Wanderlog ('Durga Chambers, above Pernia's Pop Up MEN') and magicpin. Earth Cafe has five outlets; I EXCLUDED the BKC (Wanderlog 9431977, Zomato BKC page), Juhu, Churchgate and Lower Parel branches — one HappyCow/Tripadvisor comment about a 'very cramped' Juhu outlet was not used. IMPORTANT: the longStay finding rests on a single Tripadvisor review (Dr. Gauri Awasthi, August 2024) reporting she was asked not to use her laptop; I re-fetched the Tripadvisor listing on the .in domain to verify the quote and reviewer. It is one review, hence low confidence, and it sits awkwardly beside the wifi/charging listings — an editor may want to call the cafe. Hours vary by platform, so a range is given. Zomato pages disallowed by robots.txt.
